name: Mars
source:
Mars is the first friend Rex makes in the town. She is a very kind and cheerful girl who has had a bad past with her family. She has a reputation due to her losing her temper once and knocking out 10 students at once.

[spoiler]It is revealed shortly into the game that Mars is in fact a male who dresses similarly to a girl because he loves being cute.[/spoiler]

Mars is the first friend Rex makes in the town. She is a very kind and cheerful girl who has had a bad past with her family. She has a reputation due to her losing her temper once and knocking out 10 students at once.
